exposure: comfort care and family participatory care during the perioperative period of cesarean section
cohort: This study included 90 women undergoing cesarean section, randomized into two groups.
finding: Comfort care and family participatory care during the perioperative period of cesarean section significantly alleviated postoperative pain, reduced anxiety and depression, improved stress responses, enhanced maternal self-care ability and nursing satisfaction, and decreased the incidence of complications compared to conventional care.
followup_time: 72 hours postoperatively (for some outcomes), and discharge (for others)
